construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation created within the isolated build directory

input.question: nonblank string, maximum 2000 characters
input.knowledge_base: 0..1000 documents; each has exactly id, title, content; unique unpadded ids

shared_schema.validation: One validate function is shared by library and CLI; strict JSON parsing rejects duplicate keys and nonstandard constants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: validated request -> content-term retrieval -> threshold and ambiguity gates -> cited extractive answer or explicit abstention

behavior.retrieval: Unicode case-folded alphanumeric term sets, English stop words removed; coverage is matched distinct query terms divided by distinct query terms; rank by descending coverage then ascending id.
behavior.grounding: Returned answer and citation quote exactly equal source content. Titles cannot contribute retrieval evidence.
behavior.abstention: No searchable terms, no source meeting threshold, or top-score tied documents with different content.
behavior.fixtures: All supplied fixture knowledge and questions are synthetic.
behavior.limitations: Lexical overlap cannot prove relevance, truth, or entailment. No synonym matching or semantic contradiction detection. The threshold is not calibrated confidence.

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object with status answered, exit 0
